groups.canonical_name: Extreme weather and natural disaster disruption
groups.definition: Severe weather, climate-related events or natural disasters could disrupt company facilities, suppliers and operations.
Rapid technological change and competitors could render products obsolete, erode prices and require costly R&D with uncertain returns.
Reliance on distributors that carry competing products and carry credit risk could harm sales.
Failures or disruptions of information technology systems could impair operations.
Dependence on limited or single-source suppliers exposes the company to supply shortages and disruptions affecting production.
Disruptions or yield problems at the company's own manufacturing facilities could halt production with limited ability to shift output.
Pandemics could disrupt workforce, suppliers, customers and operations, harming financial results.
Reliance on subcontractors for wafer fabrication, assembly and test with limited alternatives could disrupt supply.
Failures of vendors, exchanges, clearinghouses and financial intermediaries could disrupt business activities.
